mandate: C415 — test the cross-sectional intraday TAILDEP: TAIL DEPENDENCE COEFFICIENT / EXTREMAL DEPENDENCE vs EQUAL-WEIGHT MARKET stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1944 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; equal-weight market return m[s]=(1/10)*sum_i r_i[s]. TAILDEP scalars over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing returns, q=0.10: for each bar t, X=r_i[t-W+1..t], M=m[t-W+1..t], qx_lo=quantile(X,q), qx_hi=quantile(X,1-q), qm_lo=quantile(M,q), qm_hi=quantile(M,1-q); taildep_low[t]=|{X<=qx_lo, M<=qm_lo}|/|{M<=qm_lo}| (conditional lower-tail exceedance probability); taildep_high[t]=|{X>=qx_hi, M>=qm_hi}|/|{M>=qm_hi}| (conditional upper-tail exceedance probability); taildep_asym[t]=taildep_high-taildep_low; taildep_mag[t]=(taildep_high+taildep_low)/2. Needs indices t-W+1..t (W bars). NaN if t<W, any NaN/non-finite, conditional sample size < 10, or non-finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 4 real (taildep_low_dev, taildep_high_dev, taildep_asym_dev, taildep_mag_dev) + 2 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs and valid denominators; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W-bar window or not finite or conditional sample size < 10).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|; market m[s]=mean across assets.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing returns, q=0.10; taildep_low=|{X<=qx_lo, M<=qm_lo}|/|{M<=qm_lo}|; taildep_high=|{X>=qx_hi, M>=qm_hi}|/|{M>=qm_hi}|; taildep_asym=taildep_high-taildep_low; taildep_mag=(taildep_high+taildep_low)/2.
methodology.signals: taildep_low/taildep_high/taildep_asym/taildep_mag over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1944 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 6 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.taildep_vectorization_note: return matrix R=(T,10) built once; market m[s]=mean across assets; zero-copy sliding_window_view(R,256) and sliding_window_view(m,256) processed in chunks; per-window quantile masking (q=0.10 and 0.90); conditional lower/upper-tail counts divided by market conditional counts; validated against brute-force per-window loop with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests. Chunking keeps peak memory low.
